why: A support chip's object, the fourth kind's type its subfamily's routine spawns, holds what its spawn copied of the caller's registers: every such spawner has one shape in both games (push {lr}; push {r0,r1,r2,r5}; movs r0,#type; the fourth kind's spawn, BN4 0x08003344 and BN6 0x080033AC; then str r6,[r0,#0x2c]; str r7,[r0,#0x30]), reached by bx r3 from each game's support run (BN4 0x080EB9EA from the table 0x080220E0, BN6 0x080ED0DC from 0x0802CCB4) with r3 the spawner's own address, r4 the attack's parameters ([r7,#0xc]), r6 its power word ([r7,#8]) and r7 the chip and the attack's +6. So the object's +4 holds the parameters (the spawn's store of r4), +0x2C the power word, +0x30 the chip, and +0x3C each game's address of its spawner (the spawn's store of r1 to r3 at +0x34 to +0x3C). Read in BN6's terms where all of this is so, checked against both ROMs at each run (tools/xdiff_bn4.py support_spawners: the type's spawner of that shape in each game's table, and no routine of the type, down its jump tables, loading +0x3C): BN4's +0x3C, where it is its spawner's address, as BN6's spawner's of the run's chip's subfamily; the chip as the run's id (chip_id); and for a chip both games name the record's copies as BN6's record's (chip_id's record). A type whose spawner is another shape, or whose code loads +0x3C, is compared as it is. A chip whose code is BN4's moved (its row XREG_MOVED: PanlSht's fourth kind's 0x4F, ShotStar's 0x34, src/emu/xchips_bn4.c) has no spawner in BN6's ROM: its spawner is BN4's of that shape, the unit's entry, whose copy BN6's support run calls. Its object's chip is read as the run's id all the same; its +0x3C, the same routine's address in both, BN6's its copy read back as BN4's address by the trace's moved ranges, is compared as the number it is; and its element, which the spawner stores from r3 at BN4's +0x17 (BN4 0x080E7A6C: strb r3,[r0,#0x17]) and the recipe's immediate at BN6's +0x0E, is read at BN6's place where BN4's +0x0E holds 0 (bn4_chip_shotstar t33: 1 at BN4's +0x17 and at BN6's +0x0E). A misc routine of BN4's that spawns a fourth-kind object is read the same way for its element alone: PitRng's (BN4's misc 0x0D, BN4_MISC_ROUTINES' entry 0x080E9A36: push {lr}; push {r2,r5}; movs r0,#0x6c; the spawn 0x08003344; strb r2,[r0,#0x17]; str r6,[r0,#0x2c]), a shorter spawner whose object places itself, moved as a unit of its own (src/emu/xchips_bn4.c's PitRng: BN6's grown misc routine 0x8D), its store and the type's own read of it (BN4 0x080E9A12: ldrb [r5,#0x17]) the recipe's immediates at BN6's +0x0E. The type is read so where BN4's misc table names such a spawner of it and a row of the registry names that routine's unit (tools/xdiff_bn4.py misc_spawners, misc_object_as_bn6), and where BN4's +0x0E holds 0.
